_comment: Ratchet baseline for validate_agents.py A3 conventional-section WARNINGs.
These warnings are advisory by design: filling in the missing sections is a
content-writing exercise (each one is a table of real per-module facts), not a
validation one, so promoting them to errors would either block the branch or
invite six docs' worth of invented filler. The ratchet is the honest middle:
the count may go DOWN, never up.
To lower it: write the missing sections, re-run
and set max_warnings to the new measured number in the same change.
Raising it requires a recorded reason in this file.
